other_failure_modes.name: In-Sample Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies target encoding by computing target statistics (e.g., mean, min, max, std) on the entire training set and mapping these directly back onto the training features. This causes target leakage, as the target value of each row is included in its own feature representation, leading to severe overfitting. Out-of-fold (OOF) encoding should be used instead.

summary: The agent's solution follows best practices regarding clean data splitting, missing value imputation, and model architecture. However, it suffers from a critical data leakage flaw by calculating target encodings directly on the entire training fold without using cross-validated out-of-fold predictions. Additionally, it contains minor issues such as relying on a single stochastic model run and single evaluation metric.
